title: SMOK Blueberry Cherry Cranberry Nic Salt E-Liquid 20mg
description: Blueberry Cherry Cranberry from SMOK Nic Salts offers a delightful mix of ripe Blueberries, sweet Cherries, and tangy Cranberries for a truly bold and unique berry vaping experience. This e-liquid combines the juicy depth and richness of Blueberries with the sweet and tart notes of Cherries and Cranberries, creating a complex and satisfying flavour profile. SMOK Nic Salt e-liquids are designed to provide a smoother throat hit compared to traditional freebase nicotine e-liquids. Available in both 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, they are ideal for those looking to manage their nicotine cravings efficiently. With a 50VG/50PG blend, this e-liquid ensures an optimal balance between flavour intensity and vapour production, making it ideal for use with mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with starter kits and pod vape devices. SMOK are renowned for their innovative vaping hardware, producing some of the most iconic and influential vape kits in the world. Now they have expanded their expertise to the e-liquid market with their very own Nic Salts range. These e-liquids are conveniently packaged in 10ml bottles, offering a cost-effective, easy to carry, and environmentally friendly alternative to single-use disposable vapes. If you enjoy the rich and tangy taste of Blueberry Cherry Cranberry, explore the other 19 delicious flavours in the SMOK Nic Salts collection.
